item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena dips turmeric paper into three colourless solutions from her kitchen: soap solution, lemon juice, and pure water. She records the colour each time. Which statement about her test is not correct?

options.A: Turmeric paper turns red in soap solution, showing that soap solution is basic.
options.B: Turmeric paper can show the difference between lemon juice and pure water.
options.C: A substance is tested by dipping dry turmeric paper into the solution.
options.D: Both lemon juice and pure water leave the turmeric paper unchanged in colour.
